input.quote: 18.4 If a Terminal Party terminates its participation in this Agreement pursuant to Subparagraph 18.1 of this Agreement after the Initial Period of twenty-five (25) years, the remaining Parties and the said Terminal Party will negotiate a reasonable agreement in order to ensure the continuous operation of the said Terminal Party's Terminal Station after the Initial Period.
input.rationale: Paragraph 18 (and Subparagraph 23.3) deal only with the asset side of exit: an agreement to be negotiated to keep a Terminal Station operating (p0231, p0257), assumption of the departing Party's interests and obligations (p0232), decommissioning and liquidation (p0234) and residual third-party liabilities (p0235, p0280). Records are retained for five years (p0166) and confidentiality survives five years (p0274), but nothing requires the other Parties to provide transition or migration assistance for any defined period, and nothing requires our data or records to be returned or exported on exit. The rule's fallback therefore fails entirely, so we insert a short Subparagraph 18.8 at the fallback level (90 days' assistance; export within 30 days) rather than the preferred six-month/certified-deletion package, and we have drafted it in our favour only so that it does not create a new obligation on Teleglobe.

proposal.summary: Insert Subparagraph 18.8 requiring the other Parties to give Teleglobe 90 days' transition assistance and to export its data within 30 days of expiry or termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 18 deals only with realization of assets and residual liabilities, so we have added a short exit clause: on expiry or termination (including of our participation) the other Parties provide at least 90 days of transition assistance and export our data within 30 days. This is our fallback position; we would otherwise ask for six months' assistance at then-current rates with certified deletion.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, or of Teleglobe USA Inc.'s participation in this Agreement, the other Parties shall (a) at Teleglobe USA Inc.'s request, provide transition assistance for a period of not less than ninety (90) days; and (b) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, export and deliver to Teleglobe USA Inc. all data and records belonging to, supplied by or processed for Teleglobe USA Inc. under this Agreement.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
